description: Private same-chain swap between the native pool and the stablecoin pool; output is re-shielded. If it stops half-way, run blackpool_recover.

amount.description: Decimal amount in token units, e.g. "10" or "0.25", or "max" (send: the whole pool balance; swap/bridge: the most one operation can move). Never wei.

from.description: Pool to swap from (eth|usdc on base/arbitrum, eth|usdg on robinhood, bnb|usdt on bsc).

name: blackpool_swap
title: Private swap
